item.title: Mayor of Tralee says it’s vital next section of Northern Relief Road is completed promptly
item.description: The Mayor of Tralee says the opening of a section of the Northern Relief Road will alleviate a lot of traffic congestion in the town. 1.2km of the route was officially opened this morning, which includes adjacent walkways and cycleways. It runs from Forge Cross Roundabout to the newly-constructed roundabout at Listellick on the Tralee to Abbeydorney road - with links to the Tralee bypass and MTU Kerry. item.title: Taoiseach advises Kerry primary schools to appeal decision to cut their SNAs
item.description: Taoiseach Micháel Martin has advised the two Kerry schools affected by recently-announced cuts to their SNA staff, to appeal the decision straight away. He's also vowed to raise the issue with Education Minister Hildegarde Naughton in the coming days. Mr Martin was speaking in Tralee this morning, at the official opening of a new exhibition on the history of Fianna Fáil in Kerry. item.title: IRFU Launch Investigation Into Online Abuse
item.description: The IRFU has opened an investigation into online racist abuse directed toward Edwin Edogbo. The Munster lock from Cobh in county Cork made his Ireland international debut in Saturday's Six Nations win against Italy. Advertisement A number of racist comments were posted below the IRFU's post celebrating Edogbo's first Ireland cap. Advertisement The IRFU are working with data technology company Signify - which specialises in protecting against online abuse - and relevant authorities. ++ Advertisem

item.title: Delays expected on Conor Pass this afternoon due to film crew recording Netflix series
item.description: Motorist are advised to expect delays if driving over the Conor Pass in West Kerry this afternoon. Dingle gardaí say there’s a French film crew who are shooting scenes for a new Netflix series. In recent days the crew were also filming in Glanteenassig Forest Park. Advertisement

item.title: Over 14,300 people on waiting lists at University Hospital Kerry
item.description: Over 14,300 people are on waiting lists for outpatient and inpatient appointments at University Hospital Kerry. That’s according to figures from the National Treatment Purchase Fund for January. 14,338 people were waiting on outpatient and inpatient appointments at University Hospital Kerry, as of the end of January. item.title: Kerry Dairy Ireland to pay 37.5 cent per litre milk supplied in January
item.description: Kerry Dairy Ireland has announced its January milk price. It will pay 37.5 cent per litre, including VAT and a base-price top-up of three cents per litre quality and sustainability bonus, for milk supplied by farmers last month. In its monthly statement, the milk processor said dairy commodity markets have stabilised in recent weeks, finding a floor despite continued strong milk supply. item.title: Over €600,000 allocated to Dingle Harbour under state infrastructure programme
item.description: Over €600,000 (€606,000) has been allocated to Dingle Harbour as part of this year’s Fishery Harbour and Coastal Infrastructure Development Programme. In total, the six State Fishery Harbour Centres (SFHC), were allocated over 22-and-a-half-million euro (€22,520,000). item.title: Rally Update
item.description: Kerry crews faced snow and treacherous conditions at the opening round of the 2026 Trailer Parts & Spares Irish Forest Rally Championship in Sligo on Sunday. The inaugural Yeats Ridge Forestry Rally saw over 100 cars tackle fast and technical stages around Collooney. Colin O’Meara made an impressive debut behind the wheel of his Peugeot 208 R2, alongside co-driver Daniel Seaman.
